title.text: Discover Scuba Diving in Dubai (Jumeirah Beach)

pills.label: Up to 12 m
pills.pop_html: The dive: A real sea dive off Jumeirah Beach with an instructor beside you, down to a maximum of 12 metres (40 feet). You learn the skills first, then descend.

pills.label: No certificate
pills.pop_html: Who can join: Built for first-timers with no diving experience. Not suitable for pregnant women.

pills.label: Meet at the centre
pills.pop_html: Getting there: You meet at Nemo Diving Center, Azure Residences on Palm Jumeirah. Hotel pickup is not part of the package, so confirm transport when you book.

pills.label: Max 10 people
pills.pop_html: Group size: Small group capped at 10 participants. Instructors speak English, Arabic, Spanish, Russian and Hebrew.

best_for.pick_html: for a first dive in the actual sea without losing a whole day, because it is the cheapest option here (€86), takes 3 hours and still goes down to 12 metres.
best_for.skip_html: if you are already certified (book a fun dive in Fujairah or Deep Dive instead) or you want turtles and coral reefs, which the east coast does better.

items.a: Diving equipment, instruction.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Nemo Diving Center, Azure Residences, Palm Jumeirah.
Pregnant women.
Swimwear, reusable water bottle.

title.text: Discovery Scuba Diving & Snorkelling in Fujairah (from Dubai)

pills.label: Dive + snorkel
pills.pop_html: What you do: A guided try dive to up to 10 metres over coral reefs, then you switch to snorkel gear and swim alongside sea turtles, with mountains around the bay.

pills.label: No certificate
pills.pop_html: Who can join: No previous diving experience needed, but you must be able to swim. Not suitable for pregnant women or people with pre-existing medical conditions.

pills.label: +AED 160 transfer
pills.pop_html: Transport: Return transport between Dubai and Fujairah is arranged but costs AED 160 extra, paid on arrival. It covers both directions.

pills.label: Drinks & snacks
pills.pop_html: Included on board: Certified instructor, all diving equipment, a theory session on the boat, unlimited soft drinks, water and snacks.

best_for.pick_html: for beginners who want the full east coast version, coral and turtles in the Gulf of Oman, and the best-rated beginner trip here (4.9).
best_for.skip_html: if you cannot swim (swimming is required) or you only have a morning free, because the day runs about 8 hours.

items.a: Certified instructor, all diving equipment, theory session on board, unlimited soft drinks, water, snacks.
Dubai to Fujairah transport is AED 160 extra, payable on arrival (return).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dibba, Fujairah (Gulf of Oman).
Original passport, swimwear, towel.

title.text: Guided Scuba Dive for Certified Divers at Deep Dive Dubai

pills.label: World's deepest pool
pills.pop_html: Where: Deep Dive Dubai, a 60-metre-deep indoor pool built around a sunken city. Entry ticket is included.

pills.label: 10, 18 or 30 m
pills.pop_html: Depth: You choose the depth your certification allows: 10 m, 18 m or 30 m for advanced divers. You also choose your diver-to-guide ratio.

pills.label: Certified only
pills.pop_html: Requirements: Bring your certification card (or a photo of it) from a recognised agency and a signed waiver. Minimum age 10.

pills.label: Entry + gear
pills.pop_html: Included: Entry to Deep Dive Dubai, all equipment and breathing gases, and a professional dive guide. You make your own way to NAS Sports Complex. Not for children under 10 or non-swimmers.

best_for.pick_html: for certified divers who want the one dive you cannot do anywhere else, because it takes 2 hours in the city and goes up to 30 m.
best_for.skip_html: if you want marine life or are price-sensitive, because 2 sea dives with transfer in Fujairah (#4) cost €148, half this price.

items.a: All equipment and breathing gases, dive guide, expert advice, entry ticket.
Non-refundable.
Deep Dive Dubai, NAS Sports Complex, Dubai.
Children under 10, non-swimmers, uncertified divers, people with pre-existing medical conditions.
Passport or ID, swimwear, diving certification, signed waiver.

title.text: 2 Guided Dives for Certified Divers in Fujairah with Transfer

pills.label: 2 dives
pills.pop_html: The diving: Two guided dives at two different east coast sites: soft and hard corals, wrecks, artificial reefs and macro life like shrimps and nudibranchs.

pills.label: Transfer included
pills.pop_html: Transport: Hotel pickup and drop-off from Dubai or Fujairah is included in the price. Pickup is between 6:00 and 7:00 AM, exact time sent the day before.

pills.label: 2 stops on return
pills.pop_html: On the way back: Stops at Khor Fakkan Waterfall and the Khor Fakkan Amphitheatre on the drive back to Dubai.

pills.label: Changing rooms
pills.pop_html: At the dive centre: Women's and men's lockers and changing rooms, scuba equipment, a certified instructor or divemaster and a sound system on the boat. Bring your own towel and swimwear.

best_for.pick_html: for certified divers who want real reef diving at the lowest cost per dive (€74), because the transfer is already in the €148.
best_for.skip_html: if you are not certified or only have half a day, since pickup is 6:00–7:00 AM and the trip lasts about 8 hours.

items.a: Hotel pickup and drop-off, scuba equipment, 2 guided dives at different sites, certified instructor or divemaster, lockers and changing rooms.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Hotels in Dubai or Fujairah, between 6:00 and 7:00 AM (exact time sent one day before).
Up to 10 participants.
Passport, swimwear, towel, diving certification.

title.text: Fujairah Half-Day Scuba Dive and Snorkelling (from Dubai)

pills.label: Beginners + certified
pills.pop_html: Two tracks: Beginners get instruction and dive with the instructor at all times. Certified divers are guided by a divemaster and do two dives at different sites, depending on licence level.

pills.label: 6–7 AM pickup
pills.pop_html: Timing: Pickup between 6:00 and 7:00 AM, back at the port between 12:00 and 1:00 PM, then the driver takes you to your Dubai hotel.

pills.label: +AED 160 transfer
pills.pop_html: Transport: Dubai to Fujairah transport is arranged but costs AED 160 extra, paid on arrival, for both directions.

pills.label: Snorkel after
pills.pop_html: Also included: Snorkelling gear, life jacket, unlimited soft drinks and water. Coral gardens with colourful fish and a chance of turtles.

best_for.pick_html: for couples or groups where one person is certified and the other has never dived, because both go on the same boat for the same €107.
best_for.skip_html: if everyone is a beginner (#2 is rated higher at the same price) or anyone is under 12 or cannot swim.

items.a: Scuba equipment, snorkelling gear, life jacket, unlimited soft drinks, water, professional instructor.
Transport is AED 160 extra, payable on arrival (return); alcoholic drinks.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dubai hotels, 6:00–7:00 AM; back at the port 12:00–1:00 PM.
Children under 12, pregnant women, non-swimmers, people with pre-existing medical conditions.

title.text: VIP Private Scuba Dive in Dubai with Hotel Transfer

pills.label: 1-on-1 instructor
pills.pop_html: Private: Your own instructor for the whole session, from the classroom briefing to the dive. Instructors speak English, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Malayalam, Russian and Tagalog.

pills.label: 30–45 min dive
pills.pop_html: The dive: After a 30-minute classroom briefing and 30 minutes of shallow-water training, you dive off Jumeirah Beach to 6–8 metres for 30–45 minutes, with a fish interaction.

pills.label: Photos & videos
pills.pop_html: Included: Unlimited underwater photos and videos, full equipment, towels and slippers, plus water, juice, coffee and popcorn.

pills.label: No swimming needed
pills.pop_html: Who can join: No prior experience and no swimming skills required. Complimentary hotel pickup and drop-off in Dubai.

best_for.pick_html: for nervous beginners and non-swimmers, because it is the only sea dive here with a private instructor, no swimming requirement and photos included.
best_for.skip_html: if you are fine in a group, because #1 goes deeper (12 m vs 6–8 m) for €87 less.

items.a: Private instructor, hotel pickup and drop-off in Dubai, unlimited underwater photos and videos, full equipment, towels and slippers, water, juice, coffee, popcorn.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Bermuda Diving Center, Dubai (15-minute transfer to Jumeirah Beach).
30 min classroom, 30 min shallow-water training, 30–45 min dive to 6–8 m.
English, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Malayalam, Russian, Tagalog.

title.text: Sunken City Walk at Deep Dive Dubai (No Certificate Needed)

pills.label: 30 min at 4 m
pills.pop_html: What you do: A 30-minute session, gearing up included, with guides on a balcony-style platform 4 metres down, among sunken city props: a vintage motorcycle, a parking meter, a coffee table.

pills.label: No swimming needed
pills.pop_html: Who can join: No swimming skills and no certificate required. Minimum age 10, a parent or guardian must be present for minors.

pills.label: Teaser video
pills.pop_html: Included: Underwater walk, equipment, instructor, locker, parking and a teaser video. Upgrades include longer videos and a behind-the-scenes facility tour.

pills.label: Max 6 people
pills.pop_html: Group size: Small group capped at 6, English-speaking guides. Arrive 30 minutes early and fill in the online waiver before your visit.

best_for.pick_html: for non-swimmers and nervous first-timers who want to see Deep Dive Dubai from the inside, because no swimming or certificate is required.
best_for.skip_html: if you can swim and want an actual dive, because #1 takes you to 12 m in the sea for €62 less.

items.a: Underwater walk, equipment, instructor, locker, parking, teaser video.
Non-refundable.
Deep Dive Dubai, NAS Sports Complex, Dubai.
Children under 10.

items.q: What should I know before I go?
items.a: Arrive 30 minutes early; online waiver required; no flying or Burj Khalifa for 18 hours after.

title.text: Snorkelling at Deep Dive Dubai, the World's Deepest Pool

pills.label: 1 hour snorkel
pills.pop_html: What you do: A snorkel session on the surface of the 60-metre pool with a guide who teaches the basics, gear adjustment and a few tricks, looking down on the sunken city.

pills.label: Ages 6+
pills.pop_html: Who can join: Minimum age 6 and you must be able to swim. A snorkelling life jacket keeps you at the surface. Parent or guardian must be present for minors.

pills.label: Life jacket
pills.pop_html: Included: Snorkelling equipment and a snorkelling life jacket that keeps you on the surface. You make your own way to NAS Sports Complex.

pills.label: Max 6 people
pills.pop_html: Group size: Small group of up to 6 with an English-speaking guide. Bring passport or ID and swimwear, fill in the online waiver first.

best_for.pick_html: for families with kids from 6 who want to see Deep Dive Dubai together, because it is the lowest age limit on the page and costs €99.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to snorkel with real marine life, because the Fujairah trips (#2, #5) include sea snorkelling with turtles.

items.a: Snorkelling equipment, life jacket.
Non-refundable.
Deep Dive Dubai, NAS Sports Complex, Dubai.
